text: Celann is a Breton warrior, vampire hunter and member of the Dawnguard in .

Celethelel the Singer was an Ayleid in Cyrodiil during the First Era. In 1E 242, Celethelel fought against Pelinal Whitestrake and his companion, Huna. Celethelel killed Huna with an arrow, driving Whitestrake into a killing rampage wherein he lay waste to Narlemae, Celediil, and many other Ayleid cities.
Catia Sosia is an Imperial smith who resides in the armory in the Great Bazaar, Mournhold. She specializes in Armors and repair services.
Chaero Gemullus was an experienced Imperial trader during the Third Era. He smuggled moonsugar from southern Imperial cities to the northern Argonian settlements.
Chalone is a Redguard Commoner who resides in the Foreign Quarter Plaza in Vivec City.
Catherine Redain is a Breton who resides in Deleyn's Mill in Glenumbra. She is related to Theo Redain and Bernard Redain.
Cerise Geline is a Breton member of the Mages Guild in found at the camp in the Glenumbra Moors, High Rock.
Chamberlain Croix is an Breton chamberlain who resides in Daggerfall Castle. He can be found inside the throne room. There are several conversations with him.
Chamberlain Weller is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra.
Cesarelle Hurier is a Breton who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found walking around town.
Catherine Eriel is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found watching the workers, halfway down to Daggerfall Docks.
Chalwyn the Snow-Owl is a Nord residing in the Banking District in Mournhold.
Ceryolminwe is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Celwen is a Bosmer brewer residing in the city of Skywatch. She can be found at the The Sleepy Eaglet tavern, selling beverages.
Catonnel is an Altmer tailor who resides in the city of Dune. She sells her wares at the Artisans Alley market.
Celarion Skullcarver is a Reachman member of the Boneshaper Clan encountered alongside his mother Linele at her camp near Shor's Stone.
Celelruin is a Bosmer member of the Undaunted found at the enclave just outside Wayrest.
Celeste Ruqueville is a Breton found near The Rosy Lion inn in Daggerfall. She cannot be interacted with.
Celorien is a Bosmer guild trader offering her wares at the Windswept Stalls in Windhelm.
Celsus is an Imperial member of the Gold Coast Mercenaries. He is found in the Baandari Trading Post.
Cendalor is a Bosmer found at the outlaws refuge underneath Elden Root.
Centurion Andrin is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Riften.
Centurion Burri is a Khajiit officer of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found at their camp just outside Senalana.
Centurion Earran is a member of the Veiled Heritance found in Quendeluun.
Centurion Gavo is an Imperial soldier of the Legion of the West Weald. He is part of the forces that took over Arenthia.
Centurion Gjakil is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. He is partaking in the war against the Worm Cult in The Rift.

Centurion Mobareed is a Argonian officer of the Ebonheart Pact. He is the commanding officer at Fort Zeren, in the region of Stonefalls. Depending on the Vestige's choice, he may stay at his post at the fort's garrison, or he may relocate to the Davon's Watch docks, where he will clash against the Covenant forces.
Centurion Solinthia is an Imperial soldier of the Seventh Legion. She is part of the forces found in Razak's Wheel.
Centurion Uragor is an Orsimer soldier of the Daggerfall Covenant found in a camp just outside of Fort Arand, Stonefalls.
Cerise the Widow-Maker is a member of the Fighters Guild team who went into Spindleclutch. She lost her sanity after being exposed to the whispers for too long.
Cerwaenor is a Bosmer mystic of the Mages Guild found in the hall at the Baandari Trading Post.
Cerwil is a Bosmer member of the group of outlaws found in the outlaws refuge underneath the city of Rawl'kha.
Ceryra is an Altmer residing in the Rawl'kha Outlaws Refuge.
Cesabelle is a Breton knight of Arkay found aiding the priest Alvaren Garoutte in his search for relics in Rivenspire.
Chalaree is a brewer and owner of The Wayward Pilgrim, in Hissmir.

Champion Marcauld is a Breton Champion of the Fighters Guild and the final challenger of the first round in the Dragonstar Arena, later appearing in the tenth arena, fighting alongside Hiath the Battlemaster when he summons him. Marcauld can be spoken to before entering the Arena, near two Fighters Guild Gladiators.
Chanaius is an Argonian gatherer residing in the Silent Mire in Deshaan.
Champion of Silvenar is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall of Silvenar.
Celestial Lamia is a lamia found at the Skyreach Pinnacle in Craglorn.

Ceyran was a minor First Era Ayleid warlord who infamously created and eventually lost three separate sovereignties in Valenwood, and was even rumored to worship the Daedric Prince Molag Bal. His origins, however, are not entirely clear. It is possible that his roots began in Valenwood, after his clan fled violence in Cyrodiil against their race; however, there is also a chance that he was among the refugees fleeing the Ayleid "purges" brought about by the Alessian Empire in the fourth century. He met his death at the hands of an unknown assassin in 1E 1102.
Chanka is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Fort Virak, Stonefalls.
Cesarelle Stogrin is a Breton residing in her home in Daggerfall. She lives there with Thibault Stogrin.
Celina Gedanis is an Imperial found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Catches-No-Fish is an Argonian in who can be found sitting along the road south of Bal Foyen Dockyards after the quest "Crossroads" if the Vestige choses to help Fort Zeren.
Chaneej is an Argonian residing in Licks-Longfins's House in Ebonheart.
Cavot Themond is a Breton residing inside his house in Kerbol's Hollow.
Cayleigh Stegine is a Breton trader. She was attacked by a rampaging dwarven sphere while she was on the roads of Wrothgar.

Cesarel Hedier is a Breton noble residing in Daggerfall. He is one of the targets listed in the Litany of Blood. He can be found near the stables that are southeast of the wayshrine. As with other targets, he does wander. Hedier appears to make a circle around Blandine's Stable, as well as the Hastien and Santerre houses just east of the Fighter's Guildhall. He also switches to a path just north of there to pad around the pig pen, and Gane, Stogrin, and Landreau Houses just north of those three buildings previously mentioned.
Chantale Garcique is a Breton found inside the Hall of Judgment in Bergama.
Catina Umbranox is an Imperial residing inside her house in Kvatch.
Centurion Oranius is an Imperial soldier of the Legion of the West Weald. She is encountered inside the temple in Rawl'kha.
Chaero Sextius is an Imperial member of the Order of the Hour. He is found at the Enclave of the Hourglass.
Chanter Collatinus is an Imperial member of the Order of the Hour. He is found at the Enclave of the Hourglass.
Champion of Atrocity is a creature that appears in . They appear in the Maelstrom Arena
Caydeire Dechery is a Breton magus of the Mages Guild residing in the guildhall in the Saint Delyn Waistworks of Vivec City.
Celnard Celd is a Breton commoner residing in the Farmers and Laborers Hall in the Saint Olms Waistworks of Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Centurion Beerta is a Redguard residing in the camp north of Fort Arand. She is a member of the Daggerfall Covenant, involved in the attack on Fort Arand.
Chanter Nemus is an Imperial residing at the Great Chapel of Dibella in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Centurion Mthgrazzen is a Dwarven centurion boss that resides in the chamber room in the Gnisis Egg Mine.

{{OnlineCharacters |image = ChancellorGasconeDusant.png|Full-body ChancellorGasconeDusant_speaking.png|Dialogue screen |race = Breton |gender = Male |health = {39,959 |class = N/A |faction = Clockwork Apostles |location = Brass Fortress |region = Clockwork City |province = Morrowind |dlc = Clockwork City }} Chancellor Gascone Dusant is a Breton member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Cernunnon is a Bone Colossus boss in . He is summoned after the necromancer trio Erbogar, Mochveda, and Tuecille are defeated. He fights alongside Ravenous Revenants.
Cerunsawen is an Altmer scholar of the Mages Guild found in the library of the guildhall in Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Celice Bargeron is a Breton who can be found below the Ceporah Tower in Artaeum. She cannot be interacted with.
Cavor Merula is an Imperial Primate of the Order of the Hour, considered a warrior-priest and most devoted to Akatosh. As of the events of , he is deceased.
Chanter Amia is an Imperial found in the graveyard of Cathedral of Akatosh in Kvatch.
Chaleed-Wan is an Argonian laborer of the Bright-Throat Tribe found in the Bright-Throat Village. He has no unique dialogue.

Champion of Mehrunnez is a Xivilai found in the central area of Rimmen Necropolis. She commands her Daedra to fight against the Aspect of Darloc Brae and his undead, before joining their forces to fight the Vestige in the dungeon's group challenge. Although she is a champion of Mehrunnez, she uses the generic Xivilai lines praising Molag Bal (similar to those in the Imperial City).
Cavorus Voria is an Imperial merchant residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Chanil-Wei is an Argonian leatherworker residing in the Bog Brokers marketplace at northern Lilmoth.
Centurion Ancrus is an Imperial member of the Shields of Senchal in .
Charwich is a character mentioned in the Charwich-Koniinge Letters. He is searching for Azura's Star.
Charlotte is a dog belonging to Salomon and Renee Geonette. She can be found walking around Salomon Geonette's House in the Imperial City, Temple District.

The Chaurus Hunter is a creature that appears in . They are the adult form of the Chaurus, an insect tamed by the Falmer. When a Chaurus reaches the end of its larval phase, it forms a chrysalis. Then, after a period of deathlike stillness, the Chaurus Hunter rips out of its former shell. They are the strongest of their kind. The Chaurus Hunter Fledgling is a younger, weaker variant.
Cheedal-Gah is an Argonian merchant who lives in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. He is the owner of the Cheedal-Gah's Common Goods situated in the Port Hunding's Open Marketplace.
Chantot Geric is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. He is the magister of their branch in the Redfur Trading Post.
Charmel Favraud is a Breton priest in located in the Temple of the Divines in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She sits on the right-side chair at the end of the Temple by the altar, and wears red priest robes.
Charlotte Georence is a Breton armorer residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is one of the three vendors in the Lion's Crown Outfitters.
Charbriel Barthel is a Breton residing in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven. He is found in the southern part of the city, where he wanders the streets.
Chee-Osheeka is an Argonian residing outside the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
Charlemund Prevette is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Hallin's Stand.
Charadin is a Dunmer who has been captured and brought in Pinepeak Cavern by a group of Worm Cult agents.
Charlebert Dalielle is a Breton residing inside her home in Wayrest.
Chee-Dum is an Argonian fence and part of the group found underneath Marbruk.
Chee-Saak is an Argonian taking part in the festivities honoring the Daedric Prince Sanguine.
Chee-Sei is an Argonian found on the dockyards in the city of Davon's Watch.
Cheedal-Jeen is an Argonian found in Dhalmora. He has no unique dialogue.
Charlemic Justal is a Breton patron of the Anchor's Point Inn in Evermore.
Charloux Rarnis is a Breton farmer residing in Koeglin Village.
Charques Carme is a Breton. He is residing in the large house near the bridge leading to Bangkorai.
Chartrand Natien is an Breton Magnus residing in the Lilmoth Guild Hall of Murkmire in Black Marsh.
Chath-Jaa is a violent cultist residing in the Mnemonic Planisphere.
Cienne Sintieve is a Breton alchemist who sells all manner of alchemical supplies from her shop inside the Manor District of Ald'ruhn.
Ciindil is a Bosmer assassin who worships the Daedric Prince Mephala and can be found near Mephala's Shrine.

Cicero is an eccentric jester, and the Keeper of the Night Mother's coffin. He is found on the road north of Whiterun, near Loreius Farm, transporting the coffin of his "mother." After this encounter, he may be found within the Falkreath Sanctuary and later the Dawnstar Sanctuary, depending on the Dragonborn's progress through the Dark Brotherhood questline.
Christer is a Nord who can be found in the first level of Mistwatch North Tower. He gives the miscellaneous quest "Forgetting about Fjola."
Chief Mauhulakh is an Orsimer warrior and the chief of the Orc stronghold Narzulbur in Eastmarch.
Chief Yamarz is the Orsimer Chief of Largashbur in The Rift. He is the primary antagonist of the quest "The Cursed Tribe."
Chief Larak is an Orsimer and the chief of Mor Khazgur, the Orc Stronghold located west of Solitude. He has two wives, Bagrak and Shuftharz, and is the father of Borgakh the Steel Heart and Olur.
Chief Burguk is an Orsimer warrior, and the chief of the Dushnikh Yal stronghold.

Chuna is a Golden Saint who resides in Cylarne on the Isle of Flame, in the northwestern part of Shivering Isles. She is the warden of the Altar of Rapture. Until the Hero makes his or her appearance, she stays in the same place all day and night.

Ciirta is an Imperial heretic mage who resides in the Shivering Isles, and is the leader of the Apostles. They are located in the old fort The Howling Halls. Ciirta is one of the few people in the Shivering Isles that has knowledge of the secret of Sheogorath, although she misinterpreted Sheogorath's absence. Ciirta mistakenly believed that Sheogorath had abandoned the Realm out of fear of Jyggalag and his Forces of Order, not understanding the true nature of the Greymarch.
Chirranirr is a Khajiit thief and a member of the Thieves Guild. She resides in the South Wall Cornerclub in Balmora, where she offers both training and a variety of security tools for sale.

Chorrol Jailor is a guard who is posted at the Chorrol Jail next to Chorrol Castle. The Chorrol jailors wear the standard Chorrol guard uniform, and their specific duties are to guard the prisoners in the prison and the evidence chest the prisoners' personal items are stored in.
Ciel Nestal is a Breton Spellsword residing in the Telvanni Canton of Vivec City. She works as a retainer for House Telvanni there.
Chrelm is a Redguard warrior residing in Minabi Bandit Lair.
Chief Tazgol is an Orsimer chief residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. He is the son of Glurala the Wise and is married to Heart-Wife Sholg, with whom he had a daughter, Lokra.
Chervain Georence is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found inside the Daggerfall Cathedral, listening to Pitof's various sermons.
Chiwish is an Argonian Slave who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
Cheesh-Meeus is an Argonian Slave who resides in the slave cave of Hinnabi.
Ciara Chauvry is a Breton outlaw who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found leaning against the wall, halfway down to Daggerfall Docks.
Cherese Brigitte is a Breton innkeeper residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is the innkeeper in the Cloudy Dregs Inn, not far from the north gate in the city.

Chief Koth is a goblin and the leader of the Toothmaul Tribe. Formerly, he was a slave on Summerset and managed to break free along with other goblins. He was recently persuaded into creating an alliance with the Veiled Heritance via speaking with their envoy, Nelanya.
Chef Amadour is a Breton residing in Cropsford, Cyrodiil. He has adopted a pet goblin named Zich as he thinks it is good luck.
Chef Freki is a Nord chef who works at the Comestibulary in the Royal Bazaar in Mournhold.
Chung is a character in and one of Governor Vinticae's four champions.
Chezan the Overcautious is a Khajiit fence and part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Sentinel.
Chel is a character who may be found in Delfran's Hideout. He is also the chef for Delfran's bandits and their prisoners. He mostly cooks rat stews.
Chews-on-Moss is an Argonian residing near the crates outside the Hlan House in Quarantine Serk.
Cheesh-Mei is an Argonian fishing in the Ponds in Shad Astula. She has no unique dialogue.
Chef Neetizei is an Argonian chef residing in the city of Haj Uxith, Coldharbour.
Chental Heartwound is the leader of a group of Worm Cult agents trying to summon a powerful spectral warrior in the depths of Taarengrav.
Chews-The-Marrow is an Argonian found in the Wayrest Outlaws Refuge.
Chief Dushkul is the leader of the Barkbite Clan of Wood Orcs living in Reman's Bluff. He can be found in the Chieftain's Longhouse.
Chief Nagoth is one of the leaders of the Wood Orcs living in Jathsogur.
Chief Ulukhaz is the Orsimer leader of the Wood Orcs living in the Bloodtoil Valley.
Chieftain Agrakh is the leader of the Wood Orcs living in Dra'bul.
Chief Makhug is the Orsimer leader of the Wood Orcs as a whole. He was also the one leading the charge in the invasion of Velyn Harbor.
Chieftain Thragdosh is one of the two leaders of the Wood Orcs in who leads the Lhurgash Clan at Camp Gushnukbur.
Chieftain Frostfang is a Reachman member of the Rageclaw Clan found inside Fallowstone Hall.
Christoph Lamont is a Breton found in the city of Daggerfall in High Rock.
Churley the Beggar is a Breton beggar residing in Shornhelm.
Ciceri the Bold is an Imperial member of the Mages Guild. She is the magister of their branch in Windhelm.
Cicero Eudoxius is an Imperial merchant. He sells his wares at his store, Cicero's Food & General Goods, in the Hollow City.
Christophe Dalot is a Breton residing in the town of Dragonstar.
Chirah's Follower is a character residing in the town of Stillrise Village.
Chosumeel is an Argonian priestess of Trinimac found in the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium. She can not be interacted with.

Chub Loons are creatures that appears in . They can be found along the coastal areas and rivers of Wrothgar. They are harmless passive creatures, though if the Vestige gets too close to them, they will run a few steps away.
Chief Bolazgar gro-Bagrakh was the leader of Clan Bagrakh during the early sixth century of the Second Era.
Chief Bolg is an Orsimer found outside Frostbreak Fortress in Wrothgar.
Chief Ruzgrol is an Orsimer found at Frostbreak Fortress in Wrothgar.
Chief Shamlakh is an Orsimer chief found outside Frostbreak Fortress in Wrothgar.

Ramash or Chief Ramash is an Orsimer chief of the Tumnosh Clan. He can be found in his bed, in the Tumnosh Longhouse in the Tumnosh Clanhold near the Graystone Quarry. His wives are Forge-Wife Kharza and Hunt-Wife Bolgar. He has a daughter named Shabon.
Chief Abzug is an Orsimer chief of the Morkul Clan residing in the Chief Abzug's Longhouse in Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar.

Chief Inspector Rhanbiq is the leader of the Iron Wheel. It was initially thought that Magnifica Falorah sent him to punish the Thieves Guild for their failed heist, though it is later revealed he is actually tasked with uncovering where her dowry was taken.
Chef Donolon was a Breton chef who can be found in either Daggerfall, Davon's Watch or Vulkhel Guard depending on which faction the Vestige joins.
Cimbar is an Imperial assassin residing in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. He is in a relationship with Mirabelle Motierre.
Cidius is an Imperial drunkard found in the city of Anvil, Gold Coast. Sometimes he can be seen fighting with Axkiral, Jolippe or Chukka-Li in front of Enrick's Public House.

Ciirenas the Shepherd is a Bosmer member of the Spider Cult found within Fungal Grotto II, Stonefalls. Killing any of her three spiders will enrage her, increasing her resistance significantly each time. It is recommended for the tank to kite the spiders around to avoid AoE damage from players. After being defeated, there is a change for her to drop Mender's Mark, a unique ring.
Chukka-Li is a drunk Argonian residing in Anvil. Sometimes he can be seen fighting with Axkiral, Cidius or Jolippe in front of Enrick's Public House.
Chieftain Grimmstal is a Goblin warchief of the Shadowsilk Tribe. He captured Dithis Romori after one of his brother Denthis' spells had undesired effects and turned him into a female Goblin.
Chief Archivist Sergianus is an Imperial scholar. He got trapped in the Arboretum while searching for an important book.
Chief Dular is an Orsimer chief of the Wrothgar Orcs first met in the epilogue of For King and Glory.
Chow-Chow is an Argonian chef residing in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell. He is the owner of The Saucy Nix, and commonly serves Gushorg and Carwengil.
Cherishes-Water is an Argonian residing in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell.
Ciirta Vergilus is an Imperial residing in Molag Mar on Vvardenfell.

Chief Ogzor is the Orsimer chief of the Shatul Clan residing in Shatul Range, Wrothgar. Although he is an important subject for A Question of Succession, for the duration of the quest he is dying or deceased, and so cannot be interacted with.

Chef Toel is one of the most popular chefs in Umbriel. Lord Irrel sponsored his kitchen. Unlike most master chefs of the higher kitchens, Toel wasn't born to it. He started down working on the lower kitchens, and he made whatever was necessary to be promoted.
Chief Justiciar Suriwen is an Altmer residing in the garden of Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in the city of Shimmerene during the quest "The Queen's Decree."
Chief Gloorot is an Orsimer chief located in Exile's Barrow. He is the author of "Deep Thoughts of Chief Gloorot."
Chief Orgush gro-Bazul is an Orsimer chief of the Wrothgar Orcs first met in the epilogue of "For King and Glory." He is killed by King Kurog in a show of power.
Chief Vundrum is an Orsimer chief first met in Orsinium's Scarp Keep during the events of "The King's Gambit." He will be found attending the moot there.

Cherim was a famous Khajiit artisan in the late Third Era from the city of Orcrest. He was a master tapestry weaver whose work was hailed all across the Empire and garnered considerable praise, owning four factories that made reproductions of his work. Emperor Uriel Septim VII is said to have owned between ten to fifteen of his tapestries. Before becoming a craftsman, he was a foot soldier in the Elsweyr army who fought in the "Heart of Anequina," a decisive Khajiit victory against the Bosmer in the Five Year War during the late fourth century of the Third Era. He would eventually create a tapestry on it, including a self-deprecating insert of himself stealing the rings off of a dead wood el
Chirba is a Khajiit flute-player residing in Rimmen near Urania Barbula's House. She acts quite flirtatious to all who approach.
Cheesh-Nassa is an Argonian storehouse keeper and assistant to Naheesh Oleen of the Bright-Throat Tribe. He can be found in the Bright-Throat Village.
Chime-Maker Shuvu is an Argonian chime-maker of the Bright-Throat Tribe found near the Glade of Chimes, close to the Bright-Throat Village.
Chumbley is a camel found in Undaunted Enclave, Mournhold that is owned by Natrada. It may also be found in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr.
Chinjarsi is a Khajiit beggar who sleeps next to Hurgedor residing in The Stitches, Northern Elsweyr. She has no dialogue.
Chief Urzikh is an Orsimer in and is the chief of the clan at Mor Khazgur in Western Skyrim.

Arthur Christopher Orme Plummer (December 13, 1929 – February 5, 2021) was a Canadian actor for , who voiced Arngeir in the game itself. Plummer received various accolades for his work, including an Academy Award, two Primetime Emmy Awards, two Tony Awards, a Golden Globe Award, a Screen Actors Guild Award, and a British Academy Film Award; he is one of the few performers to have received the Triple Crown of Acting, and the only Canadian. He won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor at the age of 82 for Beginners (2010), becoming the oldest person to win an acting award, and he received a nomination at the age of 88 for All the Money in the World, making him the oldest person in the wo
Chineekath is an Argonian merchant in who resides in Gideon.
Churmi is a Redguard musician in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.
Choxusha is an Argonian residing at Lilmoth. He has no unique dialogue.
Chizbari the Chipper is a member of the Dragonguard located in Dragonguard Sanctum, Southern Elsweyr, in .
Chukka-Jekka is a member of the Dragonguard located in Dragonguard Sanctum, Southern Elsweyr, in .

Chronicler Firandil is a High Elf who is part of the Order of the Lamp from the Mages Guild who can be found within the Scholarium upon completion of the quest The Wing of the Indrik. He serves as a scribing merchant selling grimoires and scripts for use in Scribing. Firandil sells a number of scripts for gold that rotate stock every Tuesday. The achievement merchant, Caal, can be found next to him.

Claudius Arcadia is an Imperial commoner who is a prisoner incarcerated at the Imperial Prison. Claudius contacted the Night Mother through the Black Sacrament and arranged the assassination of a man named Rufio by the Dark Brotherhood; dialogue with Rufio implies this may have been in retaliation for his killing of an unspecified woman during a struggle. However, this was discovered, and he was arrested by the Imperial Watch. His house in the Talos Plaza District is currently being used as a base by the Legion.
Clarentavious Valisious is a person that can be encountered in the Battlespire. He is the author of the book Anchor Warning.
Clagius Clanler is an Imperial Trader residing in Balmora, Morrowind. He is the owner of the Outfitters shop in Balmora and wears Extravagant Shoes, Extravagant Pants and an Extravagant Shirt.
Clilias Pullia is an Imperial soldier of the Imperial Legion living in Gnisis in the West Gash region.
Claudette Perrick is the proprietor of The Gilded Carafe, an Alchemy shop in the Market District. She is an Expert in the Mercantile skill.

Cirroc is a Redguard priest of Talos who lives and works in Bruma at the Great Chapel of Talos. He also is an Apprentice Restoration skill trainer. He recruits the Hero to return The Stone of St. Alessia in the quest of the same name.

City-Swimmer is an Argonian who lives in the top level apartment of a three-story building in Bravil. She swims most of the day, exploring the canals in the city, but can be found in her house at night. She is a Journeyman Sneak trainer. Despite having a female model and voice actor, City-Swimmer refers to herself using male pronouns. Other characters refer to her using female pronouns.
Cingaer is a Bosmer Thief and criminal hiding in Hrota Cave, located north of Anvil.
Clesa is a Redguard ostler who lives with her husband Ernest at the Horse Whisperer Stables located just outside the main gate of Anvil. She sells white horses at a price of 4000 .
Cinda is an Imperial warrior who resides in Ashir-Dan in the province of Morrowind. She is a smuggler and is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Clasomo is an Imperial vampire Monk who resides in Galom Daeus with the rest of the Clan Berne. He is found on the upper level of the observatory near a door guarded by a steam centurion.
Clibergus Urgelian is an Imperial who resides in the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora.
Clinton Lylvieve is a Breton child who can be found in Dragon Bridge, "patrolling" the town with his pet goat named Lucky.
Clagius Clanler: Outfitter is a clothing merchant in western Balmora in . The first floor is the store and Clagius lives above in the second story.
Clendil is a Bosmer who resides in the left wing of the Daedric Shrine of Ald Daedroth in Morrowind.
Cindiri Arano is a Dunmer living on Solstheim. She is the wife of the second counciler, Adril Arano, and lives with him in Morvayn Manor, at Raven Rock.

Clivia Tharn was a ruler of Cyrodiil during . Clivia ruled the Empire of Cyrodiil in the absence of her husband Varen Aquilarios for three years, until Molag Bal initiated the Planemeld and overran the White-Gold Tower. Abnur Tharn had plans for her first child to inherit the throne, but by the time of the Alliance War she was "comfortably lodged in Mannimarco's pocket", and had disappeared from the public eye months before the Planemeld.
Ciralinde is an Altmer Slave being sold at the market in Tel Aruhn.
Cirges Adrard is a Breton archer and member of House Telvanni, who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton.

Ciral is an Altmer farmer in who resides in the town of Phaer situated in the zone of Auridon. Akin to most of the town, his brother is afflicted with the plague that has broken out there, although he has not contracted it himself.

Cinder-Tail is a Khajiit first encountered at the Laughing Moons Plantation, where he trains senche-tigers in order to keep the plantation free of vermin. He is later seen again at the Redfur Trading Post. He unknowingly bought stolen goods from the Hollow Moon, a gang of thieves established there. He was later detained by the guard when he got caught stealing moon-sugar.

Cirthile is a Bosmer residing in Eagle's Strand in the region of Khenarthi's Roost. He appears to have been injured, as he is residing on a bed in the makeshift hospital set up to help shipwreck survivors. He cannot be directly interacted with.
Claudius is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Elden Root.
Cimon is a Breton residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is typically found lying on the ground, on an area that overlooks the Daggerfall Marketplace. Aniette lies beside him.
Climbs Trees is a Khajiit residing in Mistral. He is found lounging on a chair at the Moonfire Forge.
Cirantille is an Altmer author who resides in the city of Skywatch on Auridon, or later Orsinium. She is the author of several books, mainly on the discussion topic of the many races of Tamriel.
Clauvis Bacqure is a Breton enchanter residing in the city of Evermore.
Ciryarel is a hostile Altmer spirit who can be found in Inner Tanzelwil.
Cleark Skye is a Breton in who can be found in Stout's Trading Post.
Cirimion is an Altmer patron at the Trader's Rest, in Velyn Harbor.
Cirithor is a Bosmer member of the Houndsmen who kidnapped The Green Lady's sister, Lanwaen.
Cirmo is a soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion investigating the presence of Covenant troops hiding in Ne Salas.
Cirtaarie is an Altmer in who resides in the town of Silsailen, on the island of Auridon. She can be found with the rest of the surviving population of Silsailen being assisted by Elenwen.
Cirterisse is the leader of the Worm Cult cell found in Aba-Loria. Killing her is a part of the "Aba-Loria Explorer" achievement.
Cirtor is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful found at the Falinesti Winter Site.
Clairene Jerick is a Breton magus with the Daggerfall Covenant found in the Merchant House at the Southern High Rock Gate.
Claudelle Sansone is a Breton refugee found in Camp Tamrith.
Clelian Berri is a Breton noble found in Daggerfall. She can be found listening to Sir Khnanya at-Salan. She has no unique dialogue.
Clorsatari is a member of Molag Bal's Council. She is found in the Planar Vortex. They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Clessia af-Dometri is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel.
Cinia Vinipter is an Imperial found in the Dragonstar Arena.
Cirunra is an Altmer woodworker. She sells her wares at her store, The Plane Truth, in Abah's Landing.
Clara Reynaud is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Clement Arne is a Breton found reading near the Anvil Mages Guild in Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.

Cleric Arvina is an Imperial priest of Arkay. He is found inside the Mages Guild branch in Anvil. He has posted a bounty for the killing of Exulus, a dangerous wispmother residing within Hrota Cave, which is responsible for the deaths of many knights of Arkay.
Clanker is a dwarven spider that appears in Stros M'Kai. He is Neramo's pet. When Neramo moves to Alik'r Desert he brings along Clanker and upgrades him into a dwarven centurion.
Cirithiel is a Bosmer found in Lanwaen's House in Deepwoods, Malabal Tor.
Cirandur is a deceased Altmer found within the Ayleid ruins of Ninendava in Cyrodiil.
Clerk Reyna is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. She is part of the team investigating the ruins of Traitor's Tor.

Cindiri Malas is a Dunmer residing in Mournhold. She is one of the many assassination targets assigned by the Litany of Blood. She can be found standing at the lamp post west of Royal Bazaar before the bridge and gazing at the statue in the center of the bazaar.

Cingor is a Bosmer crusader in who lives in Leyawiin. He is a member of the Fighters Guild, though he can never actually be found in the local guild hall. He is also actually a Mythic Dawn agent, and will attack the Hero after completion of the quest, "Dagon Shrine." Bringing him and Martin Septim to Leyawiin prior to reaching Cloud Ruler Temple, he will attack Jauffre.

Clavilla was the Queen of Taneth during the waning years of the Third Era, sometime around the Oblivion Crisis. She was among the many that rebelled against King Lhotun of Sentinel, she was also among the many that failed to stop th growing political power known as the Lhotunic. Her plan was to have various different independent guilds that were charted revoked from the Kingdom of Sentinel for worshipping Satakal, what is considered the god of everything and a Redguard counterpart to the Nordic God, Alduin. As mentioned before, her plan was unsuccessful but no negative reprucussions were made on her and her kingdom.
Cliff Skipper is a creature in . It is a non-hostile young Cliff Strider that often appears near the adult ones.
Clockwork Archivist is a Factotum residing in the Archivox in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.

City Solicitor is an Orsimer found beside the road along with a Bodyguard and a chest at one of their possible locations in Wrothgar. When spoken to, she will ask for a donation to the city of Orsinium.
Claudina Ildene is a Breton ghost hunter encountered just outside of Dusktown in Blackreach.
Clenagal is a Bosmer in who resides outside of Darsine's House in Leyawiin.
Clasomo Hosidus is an Imperial sitting at Deals and Decay of the Lilmoth Outlaws Refuge in Lilmoth. He has no dialogue.
Cindy Robinson is a voice actress for and . She is also a voice director for .
The Clockwork Registrar is a Factotum residing in Chancel of Records.
Colin Stedrine is a Breton commoner who works as a servant in Anvil Castle.
Collatinus Vedius is an Imperial commoner living in Matthias Draconis' house in the Imperial City, Talos Plaza District.
Cocistian Quaspus is an Imperial who resides in Buckmoth Legion Fort, Morrowind. Cocistian is an initiate of the Imperial Cult.
Coirtene Liore is an Imperial smuggler found in the Dwemer Ruin of Arkngthand, Morrowind.
Colette Marence is a Breton mage who can be found in the College of Winterhold.
Commander Caius is an Imperial soldier in who resides in the city of Whiterun. He is the captain of the Whiterun Guard.
Commander Maro is an Imperial and the leader of the Emperor's special security force, the Penitus Oculatus. He serves as the main antagonist of the Dark Brotherhood questline.

Colin Vineben is a Breton male Penitus Oculatus agent, who grew up in the city of Anvil. He is one of the main characters of the two novels, and . He was promoted to Inspector rank by Intendant Marall, and later became one of the best Penitus Oculatus agents. He was then commissioned by the Emperor for investigation of Emperor's son, Attrebus Mede.
Clyton J. Wiffington is a ficional character from the book Banker's Bet, written by Porbert Lyttumly.
Coldhearted Gravedigger is a Nord and one of the ten recurring targets for the Dark Brotherhood. She will appear in the Hall of the Dead in Windhelm.
Commander Devry is a Breton member of the Lion Guard residing in Daggerfall.
Collector Telandil is an Altmer who resides in the city of Vulkhel Guard, on the island of Auridon. She can be found in the city's Manor & Treasury.
Coinclerk Arawe is an Altmer banker who resides in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard. She can access the Bank, Guild Bank, and Guild Store.
Commander Parmion is a deceased Altmer residing in Glenumbra Moors, Glenumbra, in .
Colmorion is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. He is a member of the Fighters Guild.
